messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

You can now enter a **Deal name** in the reproduction controls. Named snapshots restore that name when loaded; clearing the name exports the existing unnamed format.

I also fixed snapshot imports that failed when valid JSON fields appeared in a different order. Invalid snapshots still leave the current game and draft intact.

Validation passed: 142 unit tests, 79 browser tests, type checking, and the production build.
